text:
Matt Barge, 2026-10-01, reviewing the contact sheets of the reframe-2026-10-01 run with the website agent:

"I approve the change that is being made to Victoria Shosh's crop and the framing check rule."

Context given to him before he said it: the twenty-two proposed crops were laid out as before/after panels in the
real card box, and on twenty-one of the twenty-two rows the two panels look identical, because those cards already
store object-position: top center and the crop only bakes the same window into the file. Victoria Schoch's is the
one row where the picture changes. The team-photo-framing check nonetheless failed all of them, because it compares
the file's aspect ratio with the card box's and fails below 95% of the file height being visible; it was failing
cards whose heads are whole and generating about thirty cards of proposed work with one real improvement in it.
